body.error: No coordinates in the database: every §8–§12 table is keyed by district municipality (no stations, boreholes, dams or sampling points with locations), so point layers cannot be drawn. Inflow is withheld (8_1_reservoir_operational_master): daily values in 2000 only; from 2001 to 2026 one constant value per district (Vhembe 0.0548 mm/day, 6.346 m³/s for 26 years); inflow = runoff depth × the placeholder area of 10 000 km² (Vhembe: 0.0548 mm/day × 10 000 km² = 6.35 m³/s) and outflow ≈ inflow, so storage never changes
